entities.summary: Jonathan Tropper is an American author, writer, and producer. He is best known as the co-creator of the Cinemax television series Banshee (2013–2016). He is also the creator of the Cinemax television series Warrior (2019–2023) and the Apple TV+ television series Your Friends & Neighbors (2025–present).
